findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: A non-dev caller that observes a nil cache before locking does not check it again after waiting for `entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock()`. If several requests arrive while the cache is initially empty, every one of them will serially reload the manifest and overwrite the cache even though the first request has already populated it. Besides unnecessary blocking and I/O, a later reload failure assigns `nil` at line 69 and discards a cache value successfully produced by an earlier caller, causing requests in that burst to fail. Recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` under the write lock for non-dev calls and return it when it has been populated while waiting.
